name: Loika
material: soft charcoal fur, short and dense, with a cream lower face and belly; the crest three glossy green leaves
signature: a round frog-hare: a big head fused to a round body, large eyes with cream rings, a tiny curved mouth, three leaves on the crown
surfaceWords: Surface: soft charcoal fur, short and dense, catching the light on the cheek, the back and the haunch; the lower face and belly a cream so soft it glows; the crest leaves glossy green with a lit rim.
referenceWhat: the accepted painting of Pip, the Loika's type specimen
